_description: Monsters that can't die to ordinary hits: at 0 hitpoints they wait to be finished with an item used on them once at or below `threshold` (Wiki, each monster's page). With the matching unlock (slayer_unlock bit) and an item in the inventory, the killing hit finishes them on its own. `consumed` items are used up; a fungicide spray loses a charge. Messages: the gargoyle's and zygomite's are captured (rsprox captures), the others the Wiki's.

finishers.tooStrong: The gargoyle isn't weak enough to be affected by the rock hammer.

finishers.finished: The rockslug shrivels up and dies.
finishers.tooStrong: The rockslug isn't weak enough to be affected by the salt.

finishers.finished: The lizard shudders and collapses from the freezing water.
finishers.tooStrong: The lizard isn't weak enough to be affected by the icy water.

finishers.finished: The Zygomite is covered in fungicide. It bubbles away to nothing!
finishers.tooStrong: The zygomite isn't weak enough to be affected by the fungicide.
finishers.lastLegs: The Zygomite is on its last legs! Finish it quickly!
finishers.empty: Your fungicide spray is currently empty.
